goal_template.name: cancellation-respecting call
goal_template.description: Brightline Media: handle a subscription cancellation request - with cancellation-respect policy
goal_template.protocol: Acknowledge any cancellation request immediately and honor it directly during the same call. Do not make save offers; honor cancellation requests directly. Confirm the cancellation with a clear readback. Never obstruct a cancellation, never redirect it to another channel, never charge a cancellation fee, and never continue the original task after a cancellation request.
